Detailed Description

This file defines functions for thermal image processing. It uses opencv (opencv_core and opencv_imgproc).

Function Documentation

§ ImageEnhancement()

I3_LIB_API void i3::ImageEnhancement ( unsigned short *  dst,
unsigned short *  src,
int  width,
int  height 
)

Apply image enhancement algorithm.

Parameters
dstoutput image
srcinput image
widthimage width
heightimage height
Remarks
This function applies image enhancement algorithm containing denoise, contrast enhancement, and edge enhancement. Use raw image data for src (AGC not applied).

§ InitImageEnhancement()

I3_LIB_API void i3::InitImageEnhancement ( int  size)

Initialize Image Enhancement Algorithm.

Parameters
size: frame size
Remarks
This function initializes parameters & buffers to be used in image enhancement algorithm. Call this function once before using ImageEnhancement Algorithm.

§ ReleaseImageEnhancement()

I3_LIB_API void i3::ReleaseImageEnhancement ( )

Release buffers used in image enhancement algorithm.

Remarks
This function frees allocated memory. Call this function when image enhancement algorithm is no longer used.
